mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS blog_id,b.title,b.description,b.content,b.published,b.aiSummary, c.id AS category_id,c.name AS category_name FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.categoryId = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.is_delete = 0
SELECT t.* FROM blog_tags bt INNER JOIN tags t ON bt.tagId = t.id WHERE bt.blogId = #{blogId} AND t.is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blogs (id, title, description, content, published, categoryId, createUser) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{content}, #{published}, #{categoryId}, #{createUser})
